_comment: Skill -> privacy class for WP-06's phrasing route. public = straight to cloud; google_ok = straight to cloud (Mario, 2026-09-22: Google already has this data, e.g. email/calendar/alarms/shopping list/music); gated = the result TEXT goes through the local privacy classifier (is_safe_for_cloud) first, cloud only if it passes; local = never leaves the box. Unlisted skills default to 'local' (fail closed) - see plugin_loader.py.
